resources.string: Performs taps, scrolling and text entry that you defined in your own macros, and the tap points of Trigger Areas you configured, only when you start a macro or press a trigger.

Macro Android uses the accessibility service to perform the exact steps you wrote in a macro (tap a button, scroll a list, type text) inside the apps you chose, and to inject the tap points of Trigger Areas you configured when you press the trigger overlay. It reads screen content only to locate those elements while one of your macros is running. It never records your screen, never reads password fields, never acts on its own, and sends nothing off the device. You can revoke this at any time in Settings → Accessibility or in the app’s Permission center.
Tap to continue when the device is ready.
Drag the area or its corner, drag points, tap empty space to add a point.
